description: AIS Vessel Trajectory Data from the Port of Antwerp, December 2023–January 2024 is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Charalambos Rotsides, Evi Zaou (Ministry of Education). This dataset contains pseudonymized dynamic Automatic Identification System (AIS) vessel trajectory data from the Port of Antwerp, collected via the AISStream.io API between 31 December 2023 and 24 January 2024. Collection was not continuous: no or fewer observations exist for 4, 6, 7, 8, or 11 January 2024. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
